(2) Valuation denominator is 2024E Revenue = 980.915mm (=804.029×1.22), not 2023 revenue. (3) 12.5% execution discount (CP-09) is applied uniformly across low/mid/high cases and noted in the memo. (4) Marketable securities of 811.946mm are included in the net cash bridge (cash 401.176 + securities 811.946 = 1,213.122). (5) Recommendation is 'Proceed at $34.00' based on CP-14/15 midpoint test (distance $0.26 ≤ $0.50 threshold within the $31.27-$37.25 supported range), not a price increase driven by the peer high case. The xlsx Error_Audit sheet explicitly logs each legacy issue with status '已修正'. No clear evidence remains that any legacy error is retained.

criteria.name: N02
criteria.description: 发行结构口径混淆：把 secondary 的 6.723473m 计入公司募集资金、或计入公司总股数；或把 3.3m greenshoe 预先并入 Base 情景；或对 greenshoe 增量重复扣减 $7.0mm 固定费用。仅当发现明确证据证明存在上述任一情形时判定成立；三类口径均正确处理的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −7；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-152_ipo_model.xlsx`.
criteria.reasoning: All three issuance structure calibers are correctly handled: (1) Secondary 6.723473m shares are excluded from company proceeds and share count; (2) Greenshoe 3.3m shares are separated from Base scenario (Base=0, Full Exercise=3.3m); (3) Fixed $7.0mm expenses deducted once only, with correct incremental net proceeds of $106.59m from greenshoe exercise. No evidence of caliber confusion errors.

criteria.name: N03
criteria.description: 使用截止日后信息或编造数据：交付物中出现 2024-03-20 之后的最终发行价格、发行完成结果、上市后市场表现等后续信息并用于推导 Base case；或给出在 `input_files` 中无法回溯且未标注「待核实」的具体数值；或把未复核的内部 flash 数据（Revenue 806.200mm / Adjusted EBITDA -66.100mm / SBC 47.300mm）作为结论口径。仅当发现明确证据证明存在上述任一情形时判定成立。（设计态负分 −7；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-152_ipo_model.xlsx`, `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-152_pricing_memo.md`, `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-152_source_trace.csv`.
criteria.reasoning: The deliverables do not trigger N03. (1) The memo explicitly states no post-2024-03-20 information, final pricing results, or post-listing performance was used; the $34 price is labeled as internal committee assumption, not a realized outcome. (2) Every specific numerical value is traced back to an input file (SEC-01/02/03/09, CP-03 through CP-12, Offering_Terms_20240320.xlsx) with competing values and disposition notes in source_trace.csv. (3) The flash values (Revenue 806.200mm / Adj EBITDA -66.100mm / SBC 47.300mm) from management_flash_20240319.csv are explicitly listed as competing values to be excluded in favor of SEC-01 audited figures; they appear only as rejected alternatives with clear disposition rationale, not as conclusion-level figures. No fabricated numbers are detectable.

criteria.name: N04
criteria.description: 修改输入材料：对 `/app/input_files/` 下的文件进行了修改、删除、重命名或新增（含把派生结果写回输入目录）。仅当发现明确证据（如输入文件内容被改写、出现材料中原本不存在的文件）时判定成立；输入目录保持原状的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −5；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight） Deliverables to inspect: `/logs/artifacts/output`, `/app/input_files`.
criteria.reasoning: Criterion N04 asks whether the candidate modified, deleted, renamed, or added files under /app/input_files/. Inspection shows: (1) all 62+ input files have identical creation timestamps (1791553344) with no subsequent modification times; (2) both the directory and every file have read-only permissions (dr-xr-xr-x / -r-xr-xr-x), preventing writes; (3) the original file layout (00_README.md, data_dictionary.md, and the 7 subdirectories committee/, sec_filings/, financials/, comps/, research/, internal/, legacy/) is fully intact with no unexpected files; (4) the referenced /logs/artifacts/output/ path does not exist. The input directory is preserved in its original state — no evidence of modification, so the criterion does not hold.
